system.description:
You know how to get your attacks past enemy defenses, making sure they strike true.

Effect: You must spend two Swift Actions in the same round to activate this Feat. If your target attempts to use a Talent, Feat, or other ability to negate your attack (Such as Block, Deflect, or Vehicular Combat), the target takes a -5 penalty to any attack rolls or Skill Checks it makes to negate the attack. This effect applies to the next attack you make before the end of the same round.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Clone Wars Campaign Guide
